mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses risk-free rates, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate investments.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 6.0% signals labor market deterioration, triggering corporate earnings revisions downward and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE > 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts below 1700.0 thousand units and retail sales below 615000.0 million dollars indicate collapsing consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105.0) indicates robust manufacturing output, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1700.0 thousand units signal residential sector contraction, reducing consumer spending and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1700.0.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production above 100.0 indicates strong manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate increases above 6.0% and nonfarm payrolls declines below 144000.0 thousand indicate severe labor market contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to recessionary expectations.
failure_condition: The joint increase in UNRATE and decline in PAYEMS fails to predict negative returns: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of such instances.
